h-ft.title: What a futuretest is
h-ft.body: Your book through every real episode of a kind, day by day, then kept on record as the future arrives. The record of real episodes, not a forecast.

ft-book-h.title: Your book
ft-book-h.body: Pins, a paper book, typed weights or a pasted list. Weights add to 100%. Your hedge is yours: we never offer a leg. Nothing here is a trade list.

ft-world-h.title: The world
ft-world-h.body: A scenario on record, a live event at its place, or a what-if anywhere by the geography swap. Climate keeps only the look-alikes that landed in a climate like today's.

ft-globe-h.title: The globe
ft-globe-h.body: The world is the input, your book is the output. A comet is one real thing: the event's country reaching a country where your book earns. Turn it, or read it as a list.

ft-results-h.title: The cone
ft-results-h.body: The cone is every episode's path: the median, the band, the worst and the best. Every number carries its n. The bad episodes stay on the page.

ft-odds-h.title: The odds
ft-odds-h.body: Open prediction markets that match, the crowd's price and its change on our ledger. Beside the cone, never multiplied with it.

ft-funds-h.title: Fund by fund
ft-funds-h.body: The same episodes through a fixed list of funds, in a fixed order. History, not a suggestion; nothing here picks or sizes a trade.

ft-watch-h.title: Watch it
ft-watch-h.body: Track it from today or arm it to start when a matching event lands. A rule or an alarm in the same words. The scorecard says how the cone has done.

ft-rail-h.title: The rail
ft-rail-h.body: The wire, the chokepoints, tension, the odds that moved and what is ahead, for the world you picked. Each source credited; feeds run minutes to a day behind.

ft-steps.title: Three steps
ft-steps.body: Build a book, pick a world, run it. Then read the future, stress it with your own hedge, and watch it.
